page.overview:
Who is Filip Schaff?

Filip Schaff is a fictional comic book creator in Invincible, first appearing in Season 2. He is best known as the creator of the popular in-universe comic character Seance Dog, a supernatural canine wizard who has gained a dedicated following.

Filip Schaff is of average height with a slightly stocky, broad-shouldered build. He has a neatly groomed dark brown beard and mustache, and his dark brown hair is mostly hidden beneath a navy blue baseball cap. He has a light skin tone and wears a gray zip-up hoodie over a light gray collared shirt. Around his neck is a red lanyard with an ID badge, likely for Comic Coon entry.

Filip Schaff is a friendly and approachable comic book creator with a deep passion for his craft. When meeting Mark, Filip comes across as genuinely humble and grateful, warmly responding to Mark’s admiration by signing his book and engaging in casual conversation.

During their chat, Filip reveals his passion and deep knowledge of animation, explaining the long production times and the clever shortcuts animators use, like hiding characters’ mouths or using distant wide shots to mask limited movement. His playful humor shines through as he jokes about these tricks, making the complex process sound fun and relatable.
